start: Finish screen of a saved workout, share sheet never opened before

user_sees: Sheet 'Share as a picture' with 'Send it to WhatsApp, Instagram or any app.'
The preview, 'Size' with 'Post' picked, 'Background' with 'Dark' picked
must_not: A preview that does not match the picked choices
'Story' or 'See-through' picked on a first open

user_sees: The same card in the middle of a taller 9:16 frame, not stretched; a faint glow at the bottom
must_not: A new number on the picture that the Post did not have

user_sees: The card with no background, white words with a soft shadow, the photos and the MettleUp mark in their own colours
The note 'It has no background, so you can place it on a photo or an Instagram story.'
must_not: Dark words left on a see-through picture
A dark box left behind the numbers

user_sees: The share sheet with a PNG named like 'mettleup-workout-<day>-story-clear'
must_not: A PNG with a black background for See-through
A Post-sized PNG when Story was picked

start: Another kind: the same choices on the before/after picture and the monthly report picture

steps.action: Open 'Share before and after', pick 'Story' and 'See-through'
user_sees: The photos keep their own look; only the words turn white
must_not: A progress photo made see-through or dimmed

user_sees: 'Story' and 'See-through' already picked (the choice is remembered)

start: No app can take the picture, or the drawing fails

steps.action: Tap 'Share picture' on a phone with no share target
user_sees: 'Sharing is not available' with 'This phone has no app to share the picture with.'

steps.action: Tap 'Share picture' when the drawing takes over 10 seconds
user_sees: 'Could not make the picture' with 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'
must_not: Two share sheets after trying again

start: Switch the choices on, then back, then reopen

steps.action: Pick 'Story' and 'See-through', close the sheet, open it again
must_not: The choices back to Post and Dark by themselves

user_sees: The picture exactly as before any change
must_not: A glow or shadow left from the other choices

start: What the picture can give away

steps.action: Switch between every size and background and read the picture
user_sees: The same words and numbers in every variant
'The picture never shows your name, your gym or your body weight.' (or the gym version)
must_not: A number added in one variant that could be divided back to body weight
The member's name on the picture
